headline: What Is Collateral? Meaning, Types and How It Works
description: Collateral is an asset you pledge to secure a loan. Learn the types, how secured and unsecured loans differ, and when a personal loan needs none.
keywords: what is collateral, collateral loan meaning, collateral loans, secured loan, unsecured loan

howto.name: How a Secured Loan Uses Collateral, Step by Step
steps: Hand the original ownership papers to your lender.
Your lender has the asset valued, usually through an empanelled valuer.
A share of the assessed value is sanctioned and paid out, not the whole of it.
On full repayment the lender releases its charge and returns the original documents, within 30 days under RBI rules.
